title: Construct restored compensation forests for the staged words
body:
## Summary

Replace the frame-zero compensation in the two pinned staged 644/660 words with an explicitly restored target forest and 88 disjoint helper pairs. The local circuit drops from 5,736 to 2,288 additions, with a fully charged saving of 41,162 real-component scalar primitives per orientation. The same-matrix target-only forest is proved minimal within the signed-unit single-parent forest class; the two-sided circuit is one deterministic greedy construction.

## Scope and limits

This is one finite compensation substitution. It preserves the complete paid recursive profile and makes no improved kappa claim. Arbitrary dirty targets and helpers, literal inverses and duals, all full-word scalar operations, and every preparation/restoration are included. The backward exact coefficient row sum worsens from 169 to 181 and the conservative bit envelope from 95 to 97. Native phase interpretation, physical zero erasure, rounding, owner allocation and all-size supplier admission remain open. No global or helper-matching optimum is claimed. Historical C01 factory screens are preserved only as provenance.

## Test plan

CPython 3.12 standard-library registered replay, independent all-edge MST/helper-score and arbitrary-input operator checks, independent whole-word/free-warp and emitted scalar projection checks, and actual acceptance controls. The final committed package passed its source-history/byte preflight and all four registered commands. All four commands also pass from the read-only Git-free committed export. Automatic [registered-package CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39429636979) passed at exact head `acb22886813c73a95ce5eb4b67805defb687b879`.

## Sources and credit

Scientific source: PR #3605 at `3efbb5de06a49ffeea6684482f2d3fe48cdca3fb`; exact retained-main byte aliases are documented for the source-history gate. Prior signed-forest and two-sided methods, including PR #1080 at `803e080e181229a3af2196b7a13615c9d81ae10d`, are credited and compared on their actual distinct matrices. Related-work, inherited source notices and the full source manifest are included. Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate AI mathematical reviews are not independent human review or formal-kernel evidence.
